title: fix(plugin-approvals): word the record-lock refusal in the writer's locale
body:
Fixes #34060

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:审批锁定记录时的拒绝提示(409 RECORD_LOCKED)改为按请求语言输出,中文用户看到「项目「华东仓储客服平台实施」正在审批中，已被锁定，审批完成前无法编辑」。
- 为什么改:其它记录拒绝提示早已按请求语言返回,唯独这句永远是英文,用户在被拦住的那一刻读不懂原因。
- 风险与回滚:只换句子,错误码、409、`RECORD_LOCKED: ` 前缀和英文原句逐字不变;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`(`recordLockRefusal` 与 `refusalLocalization`)、`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`(四个新键的四种语言文案)、`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approvals-plugin.ts`(把 i18n 服务传给锁钩子)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中 zh-CN 用例断言中文句子。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The approval record lock's per-row refusal is rendered through the shared Operation Message Catalog (`renderOperationMessage`, `@objectstack/spec/system`), the catalog the record door's other refusals already use (`record_write_denied`, `record_access_denied`, and this plugin's own `approval_recall_not_submitter`). No new mechanism.

- `packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`: four keys, one wire code, picked by what the hook has in hand: `record_locked` (`{{object}}` and `{{title}}`), `record_locked_untitled` (`{{object}}`), `record_locked_unlabeled` (`{{title}}`) and `record_locked_opaque` (nothing). They ship in every locale the catalog carries (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`), the same set as the sibling record-door refusals. English is byte-identical to the old template literal.
- `lifecycle-hooks.ts`: `recordLockRefusal` picks the key and passes the label and title as parameters. The locale is `HookContext.session.locale`, which the engine copies from the request envelope. The object label is `objects.OBJECT.label` in that locale, read through the plugin's existing `readerLabelsFor` (negotiated, so a bare `zh` reaches `zh-CN`). It falls back to the declared label and never to the API name. A deployment `errors.record_locked*` override wins, as for every catalog key.
- `approvals-plugin.ts`: `bindApprovalLockHook` takes the lazily read `i18n` service as a new optional fourth parameter. Absent, the built-in catalog still answers in the writer's locale.
- Unchanged: `code: RECORD_LOCKED`, `statusCode: 409`, the `RECORD_LOCKED: ` prefix, the error's own property set, and the three operator-facing lock refusals.
- Changeset: patch for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` and `@objectstack/spec`.

## Tests

- `record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts`: a new top-level describe on the real rig (ObjectQL, sqlite, real hook). It covers zh-CN titled and untitled, a bare `zh`, en-US, an unknown `xx-YY` falling back to English, no locale, no i18n service, a deployment override, and a throwing i18n service. Each case asserts `code`, `statusCode` 409, the prefix, and that nothing reached the store.
- `record-lock-batch-row-status.integration.test.ts`: the bulk-row path through the real `updateManyData` and `batchData` upsert loops. The zh-CN row carries the Chinese sentence and the en-US row carries the existing English sentence. Both rows keep `code` and `httpStatus` 409.
- `operation-message.test.ts`: a new top-level describe. Every locale defines the four keys with exactly their placeholders, the English is byte-identical, and an unknown locale falls back to `en`.

## Acceptance notes

- The re-measure used a throwaway REST-level boot (`bootStack`, real approvals and trigger plugins, a locking approval flow, a zh-CN pack labelling the object 项目). It was run on main and on this branch and is not committed.
- `check:platform-checklist` (red on main before #34435) is not among this diff's derived gates. #34435 is in this branch's base, a121e29c28.
